feedback: The geometry's 5 sensors arranged symmetrically and slightly forward provide good line detection coverage, which helps reduce line loss events and rms error. The moderate body size and wheel track offer a stable platform that the controller can handle well without aggressive compensation. However, the sensor positions are all slightly forward (y positive), which may cause the robot to react slightly late to sharp turns since no sensors are placed behind the front line. This requires the controller to be more cautious in turning, limiting speed. Also, the sensor size of 0.012 is a good balance but could be tested against a larger size (0.016) to improve noise robustness further, especially on rougher tracks.
requested_changes: sensor_positions: add one or two sensors slightly behind the front line (y negative) to improve early detection of sharp turns
sensor_size: try 0.016 to test improved noise robustness
wheel_track: consider increasing to 0.16 to enhance stability during turns
